lines: Aankhon ka tha qusoor, na dil ka qusoor tha
couplets.en: Neither my eyes nor my heart was to blame.

lines: Jo mere saamne aaya, mera ghuroor tha
couplets.en: It was my own pride that stood before me.
Someone surely cared for this restless heart.

lines: Maana ki tum na the, koi tum-sa zaroor tha
couplets.en: You were absent, yet someone like you was there.

lines: Aankhon ka tha qusoor, na dil ka qusoor tha
couplets.en: Neither my eyes nor my heart was to blame.

lines: Aisa kahaan bahaar mein rangeeniyon ka josh
couplets.en: When did spring ever blaze with such colour?

lines: Shaamil kisi ka khoon-e-tamannaa zaroor tha
couplets.en: Surely some ruined longing lent it colour.

lines: Aankhon ka tha qusoor, na dil ka qusoor tha
couplets.en: Neither my eyes nor my heart was to blame.

lines: Lagte hi thes toot gaya saaz-e-aarzoo
couplets.en: At the first blow, the instrument of longing broke.

lines: Lagte hi thes toot gaya saaz-e-aarzoo
couplets.en: At the first blow, the instrument of longing broke.

lines: Milte hi aankh, sheesha-e-dil choor-choor tha
couplets.en: The moment our eyes met, my heart shattered like glass.

lines: Aankhon ka tha qusoor, na dil ka qusoor tha
couplets.en: Neither my eyes nor my heart was to blame.

lines: Jo mere saamne aaya, mera ghuroor tha
couplets.en: It was my own pride that stood before me.
My eyes were free of blame.
